segments.sn7.6:1.2: Atha kho jaṭābhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn7.6:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.sn7.6:1.4: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jaṭābhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn7.6:2.3: Taṃ taṃ gotama pucchāmi, ko imaṃ vijaṭaye jaṭan”ti.
segments.sn7.6:3.1: “Sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño, cittaṃ paññañca bhāvayaṃ;
segments.sn7.6:3.3: Ātāpī nipako bhikkhu, so imaṃ vijaṭaye jaṭaṃ.
segments.sn7.6:4.1: “Yesaṃ rāgo ca doso ca, avijjā ca virājitā;
segments.sn7.6:5.3: Paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā ca, etthesā chijjate jaṭā”ti.
segments.sn7.6:6.2: “abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe … aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosī”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe jaṭābhāradvājoti bhāradvājovesa, jaṭāpañhassa pana pucchitattā saṅgītikārehi evaṃ vutto.
